title: Boku no Hero Academia: Training of the Dead
native: 僕のヒーローアカデミア トレーニング・オブ・ザ・デッド
synopsis:
The story takes place after the field training arc in the second season, and revolves around a practice session between Izuku's class and Isami High students at Yuuei Academy.

Note: This OVA was bundled with the 14th volume of the manga
